text: Good evening. I am fostering a baby boy, 3 months old, he came to us few weeks ago. Since yesterday he is having catarrh, the nose is running and sometimes blocked, and he is sneezing well well. I checked his temperature now and it is 38.1, I think the thermometer is correct, I did it twice. Alhamdulillah it is not higher but I know for small baby I should not just sit down on it. Please what should I do tonight, I dont want to be giving any medicine without asking first. Jazakallah khair
